title: Head of Product
description:
**What you'll do**




  




* Own product strategy and roadmap across client projects
* Set the design direction and quality bar for everything 360 Labs ships
* Translate client goals into product requirements, then into interfaces and experiences that actually work
* Work hands\-on in design tools, not just reviewing other people's work
* Partner directly with engineers to make sure design intent survives implementation
* Build lightweight product processes that fit a small, fast\-moving team, not enterprise\-style overhead
* Represent product and design thinking directly to clients



  





**What we're looking for**




  






 Experience
 




  




* 4\+ years in a product role, ideally with real design ownership, not just product management
* A genuine design background, including study of design theory and philosophy, not only tool proficiency
* A strong portfolio showing practical work: products or interfaces you've designed that shipped and were used



  






 Design and product judgment
 




  




* Deep understanding of the "why" of design i.e. theory, aesthetics, and philosophy, and the "how" i.e. usability, interaction design, and visual craft
* An eye for what makes a product feel considered rather than merely functional
* Comfort moving between big picture product strategy and small detail, like spacing, type, and copy



  






 AI\-native mindset (essential)
 




  




* You already use AI tools daily across research, design, writing, and prototyping
* You can prompt, guide, and critically evaluate AI output, in both product thinking and design work
* Curiosity about how AI changes what's possible in product and design, not just how it speeds up existing work



  






 How you work
 




  




* Strong ownership: you care about outcomes, not just deliverables
* Clear, confident communication with engineers, clients, and leadership
* Comfortable in a small, fast\-moving team where you'll shape the process rather than follow one
* Able to manage your own time and priorities, especially in a remote setup



  






 Nice to have
 




  




* Formal education or serious independent study in design, such as a degree, or deep self\-study of design history and theory
* Experience designing AI\-native or AI\-powered products specifically
* Prior work in a startup, agency, or consultancy setting

title: Manager Automation & AI
description:
Manager Automation and AI
   

  

**Location \- Remote , India**
**Summary**
 The AI Automation Manager sets a strategy, roadmap, and executes AI, workflow, and agent‑based solutions across HR and enterprise platforms to support evolving ways of working. This role focuses on hands‑on implementation—designing workflows, building AI agents, and automating processes to improve efficiency and employee experience. The role partners with HR, IT, and Legal to deliver scalable, compliant AI solutions that drive adoption and measurable business value.
   

  

**Major Duties And Responsibilities**
* AI Use Case Delivery \& Execution: Sets a strategy and roadmap around AI \& Automation delivery, and execute assigned AI, agents, workflow, and automation use cases aligned to the established HR and digital roadmap. Own hands‑on requirements gathering, build/configuration, testing, and deployment to ensure solutions are practical, compliant, and delivered on time.

Partner with IT and vendors to ensure integrations, data usage, and security requirements are met.

Work directly with HR Operations and COEs to align AI solutions with standardized processes and operating models.
* Change Support \& Adoption: Execute defined change and adoption plans for AI deployments, including coordination of training, communications, and user enablement materials. Monitor user feedback and adoption trends, escalating risks and improvement opportunities as needed.
* Measurement, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement: Track delivery milestones, adoption metrics, and operational performance of AI solutions. Ensure implementations align with data privacy, security, and responsible AI guidelines, and recommend continuous improvements based on usage and outcomes.
* Design, build, configure, test, and deploy AI agents that support HR processes and employee experiences.
* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of AI\-powered HR solutions, from use case identification through deployment and adoption.
* Hands\-on AI agent configuration and automation configuration experience.


**Experience And Education**
 Graduate in any field
   

  

 5 – 7 yrs with 2\-3 years experience in AI
   

  

 Experience in Copilot \& Joule Studio, Claude, SuccessFactors, WalkMe, ServiceNow and other HCM, AI \& Automation tools

title: Product Manager REQ_75
description:
Greetings, future Product Leader!
   

  

 Embark on an exciting journey into the realm of product management with 3Pillar! The Product Manager at 3Pillar is the product authority on a client engagement — or a close consulting partner to one. Engagements vary on some, you'll own the vision, roadmap, and backlog outright, with the client looking to you as their product lead. On others, you'll work alongside a client's own Product Manager or Product Owner, contributing product expertise, shaping thinking, and driving execution without holding formal authority. You need to be effective in both modes. In either case, you work in close partnership with a Delivery Lead who owns the client relationship, account health, and delivery accountability which lets you stay focused on the product itself.
   

  

 This isn't an internal product role. You're embedded in a consulting environment, which means you need to be client\-fluent: able to facilitate a requirements workshop, articulate a trade\-off clearly to a business stakeholder, and translate messy client problems into crisp, executable product work. You bring both strong product instincts and professional habits, including thoughtful use of AI tools that make you and your team faster and more effective.
   

  

 Role: Product Manager
   

  

 Work Location: Remote
   

  

 Experience: Minimum 6 years of experience as Product Manager in client facing role handling Data Engineering/Migration product.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog when serving as the engagement's product authority; partner closely with and advise a client PM or PO when working in a consulting support role
* Serve as the product domain expert in client\-facing sessions — facilitating requirements workshops, surfacing trade\-offs, and translating business needs into clear product decisions
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and ensure the team has what it needs to execute — a prioritized, well\-groomed backlog ahead of planning, clear product direction for refinement, and demos that reflect meaningful progress toward goals
* Partner with UX on research — help frame the right questions, engage with findings from interviews and usability tests, and translate user insights into product priorities and decisions
* Define, track, and report on product KPIs and OKRs; use data to drive prioritization
* Communicate product status, risks, and decisions clearly to the delivery team, Delivery Lead, and client stakeholders
* Partner with the Delivery Lead to support pre\-sales activities — provide product expertise on scope, solution approach, and feature\-level estimation
* Integrate AI tools across the SDLC — accelerate research synthesis, documentation, backlog management, and stakeholder reporting
* Identify opportunities where AI\-powered capabilities could create meaningful value in client products
* Coordinate effectively across globally distributed delivery teams in multiple time zones
* Experience in writing clear and detailed user stories
* Ability to work closely with the team to refine requirements and translate them into actionable stories.


 What You Bring
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

* 6\+ years of experience in product management, with a track record of shaping software in an Agile environment
* 2\+ years in a consulting, agency, or professional services environment — or demonstrated equivalent client\-facing experience
* Experience managing a product backlog end\-to\-end and working across the full product lifecycle
* Comfortable operating in fast\-changing, client\-driven environments with shifting priorities
* Strong knowledge of data and data migration


 Consulting \& Collaboration Skills
   

  

* Effective in both modes: can serve as the product authority when that's the engagement model, and can work alongside a client PM or PO as a trusted consulting partner when that's what's needed
* Able to influence and shape product direction without formal authority — makes ideas land through clarity, evidence, and credibility rather than title
* Experienced facilitating requirements workshops and structured discovery sessions with client stakeholders
* Strong communicator — synthesizes complex product trade\-offs into clear narratives for both technical and business audiences
* Collaborative across disciplines: engineering, UX, QA, program management, Delivery Leads, and client product teams
* Data\-literate — can define product metrics, interpret results, and use them to drive prioritization conversations
* Adaptable and effective on globally distributed, cross\-cultural delivery teams


 AI Fluency (Required)
   

  

* Integrates AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Jira AI) into daily product workflows as standard practice
* Uses AI to accelerate documentation, research synthesis, backlog management, and reporting
* Evaluates AI outputs critically; can coach team members on effective, responsible use
* Understands the productivity and quality impact of AI tooling across the SDLC
* Can identify where AI features create genuine user value vs. where they add complexity without benefit
* Familiar with basic considerations for AI product features: data requirements, latency, trust, and transparency


 What It's Like to Work at 3Pillar
   

  

 At 3Pillar, we create an environment where people can do their best work while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance.
   

  

* Flexibility \& Well\-being – Our remote\-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where you perform best, while prioritizing your well\-being and personal commitments.
* Global Community – Collaborate with talented colleagues across the globe in a culture built on connection, support, and shared success.
* Your Voice Matters – We foster open communication and multiple feedback channels, ensuring every employee has the opportunity to be heard and make an impact.
* Growth \& Development – Gain exposure to diverse clients, industries, and challenges that accelerate learning and career growth.


 Our culture is guided by four core values: Collaboration, Outperform, Respect, and Evolve—the principles that shape how we work, grow, and succeed together.
   

  

 Thank you,
   

  

 Kiran Dhanak
   

  

 Talent Acquisition Manager
   

  

 3Pillar Group

title: Product Director - Consumer
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

 We are seeking a Product Director to define the strategy and vision for our Consumer Products. This role provides leadership while delivering cohesive, high\-quality experiences that communicate value effectively.
   

  

 The Product Director owns prioritization and roadmap planning ,balancing platform changes, technical constraints, and business needs. This role drives alignment across engineering, product, and data teams, manages dependencies, and ensures demo strategy remains current with market trends, customer expectations, and broader business objectives.

* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and priorities for complex, cross\-functional initiatives in fast\-moving technical environments
* Strong understanding of modern cloud platforms and distributed systems, with experience aligning demo or solution environments to multi\-tenant, platform\-based architectures

title: Business Manager
description:
**Position Summary** 
 :
   

  

  

 The Business Manager is responsible for overseeing the business operations within the assigned region. This role involves managing a team of employees and consultants, achieving profitability goals, and ensuring efficient operations. The Business Manager collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external customers to drive growth, execute strategic plans, and ensure compliance with, LEGAL, regulatory and quality standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales, market development, and key account management, with a focus on driving sustainable, profitable growth. Additional knowledge and experience on product registration will be preferred.
 


  


**Role Responsibilities** 
 :
 


  

  
* Achieve annual profitability goals by managing the regional team, portfolio, and strategy, reflected in the region's P\&L.
  
* Establish annual working plans with internal stakeholders and key customers to capture growth opportunities for products in the region.
  
* Oversee daily operations, including budget management and setting performance objectives for the team.

* Developing trial protocols, coordination with the universities and CROs for data generation and knowledge on registration process will be required.
  


  


**Education** 
 :

 • Proven experience managing key accounts and customers, with a track record of successful contract negotiations, A/R CONTROL and strategic partnerships.

title: Product Manager – AI Security
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 November 2026 or February 2027
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 We're hiring
 **two technical Product Managers** 
 to own core areas of this new AI security platform.
   

  

 You'll join one of two workstreams:
   

  

* Cloud Discovery: Build a continuously updated inventory of the AI agents, models, and AI\-enabled applications running across customers' cloud environments, including the data and permissions they can access. This role requires strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud security.
* AI Security Platform: Own a core area of the platform across gateway, agentic security, forensics, or shared platform capabilities, working closely with engineering, security research, design, and enterprise customers.


 Both roles require a PM who has
 **shipped B2B security or infrastructure products** 
 , is technically comfortable working with engineering teams, and uses AI tools as part of their daily product workflow.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization for your product area from discovery through launch.
* Lead customer discovery with CISOs, security architects, and cloud/AI platform teams, translating customer needs into clear problem statements and PRDs.
* Partner with engineering and security research on scope, technical trade\-offs, and delivery, and participate in technical design reviews.
* Define success metrics and ensure the product measures adoption, coverage, and detection effectiveness.
* Work with product marketing, sales engineering, and support on positioning, enablement, and launches.
* Track the evolving AI security landscape, including agent frameworks, LLM providers, regulation, and competitors, and translate relevant developments into product strategy.
* Use AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and day\-to\-day product work.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, including 2\+ years working on security, cloud infrastructure, or developer\-facing products.
* Proven track record of shipping products used by enterprise security or infrastructure teams, with measurable outcomes.
* Strong technical fluency: comfortable reading API specifications, discussing distributed\-systems trade\-offs, and understanding how LLM applications and AI agents are deployed.
* Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear PRDs, decision documents, and executive updates.
* Practical, daily use of AI tools and LLM/agentic workflows in your own product work.
* Fluent English and comfortable collaborating with distributed teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast\-moving environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Product experience in cybersecurity, including DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, CSPM/CNAPP, or AI security.
* Strong practical knowledge of a major cloud provider, including services, IAM, and inventory/audit APIs.
* Engineering background or hands\-on scripting experience, particularly Python.
* Experience working with AI compliance and regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic workflows into product teams.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your own product work, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed your workflow.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and decision\-making** 
 , not simply as a writing or autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Shape a new product line at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Work directly with engineering, security research, and enterprise customers on emerging security challenges.
* Own a significant product area with high visibility and influence.
* Help define how enterprises discover, understand, and secure AI systems.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

title: Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 Consulting Manager role in a global financial services practice responsible for delivering payment transformation and messaging optimization programs using SWIFT MT messages and ISO XML 20022 standards. The role focuses on advisory solution design and implementation oversight in a hybrid work model during day shifts ensuring secure efficient and compliant cross border payment operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead complex consulting engagements for financial institutions focused on modernizing cross border payment flows using SWIFT MT messages and ISO XML 20022 standards to achieve measurable gains in efficiency and compliance.
* Oversee end to end assessment of current payment messaging landscapes including processing workflows and system interfaces to identify gaps against evolving industry regulations and scheme requirements.
* Provide detailed advisory on migration strategies from existing SWIFT MT based processes toward ISO XML 20022 formats ensuring continuity of business operations and minimal disruption to clients.
* Drive design of target state payment messaging architectures that integrate SWIFT services core banking systems and downstream applications to support scalable and resilient transaction processing.
* Coordinate with product owners architects and operations teams to define functional and nonfunctional requirements for new or enhanced payment and messaging solutions aligned to client priorities.
* Develop clear and structured documentation including business process maps data models and message specifications for SWIFT MT and ISO XML 20022 to support implementation and testing activities.
* Guide testing strategies for payment messaging transformations including creation of test scenarios validation of message mapping and resolution of defects impacting transaction quality or timeliness.
* Analyze operational and financial metrics related to payment volumes straight through processing rates and exception handling to recommend targeted process improvements.
* Collaborate with risk and compliance stakeholders to ensure that SWIFT payment and messaging solutions adhere to regulatory expectations information security standards and industry best practices.
* Present concise and insightful findings to client management teams highlighting business impacts associated with messaging changes and providing clear recommendations for phased implementation.
* Support internal capability development by sharing knowledge on SWIFT MT standards ISO XML 20022 message structures and leading practices in payment transformation across consulting teams.
* Contribute to proposal creation and opportunity shaping by translating client needs in payment and messaging domains into well structured engagement plans and value propositions.
* Engage in continuous improvement of delivery methods by refining templates accelerators and reusable assets that reduce time to value for payment messaging consulting projects.


**Qualifications**
* Possess a strong foundation in SWIFT MT messages including understanding of core financial message types their fields and associated processing flows across correspondent banking networks.
* Demonstrate practical experience with ISO XML 20022 messages covering payment initiation clearing settlement and reporting structures as applied to real world implementations for financial institutions.
* Apply working knowledge of SWIFT payment and messages platforms including connectivity options and interface mechanisms to advise on optimal integration approaches with client systems.
* Bring proven consulting experience within financial services or payments domains spanning at least nine years with responsibility for delivering complex client projects and achieving defined outcomes.
* Show capacity to communicate technical messaging concepts in clear business oriented language enabling client stakeholders to make informed decisions about payment transformation journeys.
* Exhibit familiarity with hybrid work models and demonstrate ability to coordinate onsite and remote collaboration effectively during day shifts to maintain project momentum.
* Display strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to interpret payment data transaction flows and exception patterns to recommend practical remediation steps.
* Value inclusive and collaborative ways of working that encourage diverse perspectives and foster transparent interactions with client and internal teams throughout engagement lifecycles.

title: Co-Founder
description:

title: Associate Principal Product Manager - Networks
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The team**
 As part of the Product Management organization, we develop the platform that drives the next generation of enterprise intelligence and process improvement. We are a team of product enthusiasts who like to push the boundaries of the status quo and drive the product forward with innovative thinking.
   

  

 The Data Foundation \& Networks team is dedicated to revolutionizing how businesses connect and collaborate. Our mission is to create a seamless, efficient ecosystem that streamlines processes for our clients. Because data integration is the bedrock of our platform, our team focuses on building the pipelines that allow different enterprise ecosystems to securely ingest, manage, and share critical data at scale.
   

  

**The role**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Associate Principal Product Manager** 
 to lead our Networks initiative. This exciting solution aims to transform how businesses interact with their partners, suppliers, and customers by enabling them to share data securely and efficiently.
   

  

 You will be responsible for defining the platform vision and strategy for our Networks product. To succeed, you need a deep technical DNA combined with expertise in data sharing and business networks. You will transform technical complexity into seamless plug\-and\-play data\-sharing experiences for the world’s largest enterprises leveraging Celonis Intelligence.
   

  

**The work you'll do**
* Define the vision, build, and execute the roadmap for our Networks product aligned with broader business goals.
* Partner closely with engineering to optimize ingestion capabilities so network participants can share massive enterprise datasets smoothly.
* Work directly with customers, engineering teams, and the go\-to\-market organization to deeply understand the data\-sharing needs of network participants.
* Leverage your domain expertise in modern ETL/ELT landscapes to identify key product features, integration points, and collaborative use cases.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for Networks, championing its data\-sharing features, security protocols, and value proposition both internally and externally.
* Establish partnerships with key players in the network ecosystem to foster innovation, navigate complex third\-party data architectures, and drive platform adoption.
* Monitor key product metrics and performance indicators, evaluating feature adoption and data throughput to inform decision\-making and continuous improvement.


**The Qualifications You Need**
* 6\+ years in product management, with at least 3 years focused on enterprise software solutions.
* Strong understanding of data ingestion patterns and protocols.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and understanding complex business processes and challenges.
* Ability to hold your own in architectural discussions with Engineering while simplifying those concepts for C\-level executives.
* Proven track record of crafting vision and strategy for complex enterprise software products and successfully launching them to market.
* Strong analytical skills with a love for using data to optimize system performance and drive actionable product decisions.
* Exceptional ability to influence without authority and tell a compelling story about the why behind the what.


**Nice to have**
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business to connect technical network performance to broad enterprise ROI.
* Familiarity or experience with modern data management tools like Databricks, or Snowflake.
